topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Wait, what do you mean the building's going condo? Like, it’s just... changing overnight or what? This was my sanctuary, my place to breathe, and now it’s like everything’s up in the air. Rooms that were once just doors down are about to go behind walls way thicker than before. And the cost? Oh man, who can even afford that jump? I’m just trying to keep my head above water here. I mean, sure, change can be good, but this feels like it’s coming out of nowhere, you know? What are we supposed to do? I don’t want to lose this place. It’s more than just a building; it’s where I crafted my life.
